_readme: A REAL GET /v1/quiz response, captured from the live API on 2026-08-27.
Not invented: these are the server's own keys, prompts and option strings, so
the fixture renders what production renders.
Recapture it whenever the server edits the quiz — POST /v1/auth/otp, verify,
then GET /v1/quiz with the bearer token. Nothing in src/ needs to change; the
funnel reads the definition rather than knowing it.
quiz_version  string, sent back on submit to pin the answers
questions[]   key, prompt, options[], multi?, scored?, required?, requires?{key,value}
Note: options are DISPLAY strings ('Female', 'Instagram'), not machine keys, so
the screens render them verbatim. And `platforms` carries required:false — the
one question a visitor may leave blank.

questions.prompt: Are your accounts public or private?
What kind of content do you share?
Has your likeness been misused online before?
How do you monitor whether your likeness is being misused online?
options: I use a service that monitors my photos
I rely on friends and family to tell me
